command:
set -euo pipefail
start=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ)
printf '{"event":"archflow_application_start","timestamp":"%s"}\n' "$start"
arch=$(uname -m)
ffver=$(ffmpeg -version | sed -n '1p' | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
printf '{"event":"archflow_runtime","architecture":"%s","ffmpegVersion":"%s"}\n' "$arch" "$ffver"
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=1280x720:rate=30 -t 12 -c:v libx264 -preset medium -crf 23 -pix_fmt yuv420p /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4
codec=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
width=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
height=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
frames=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=nb_frames -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
duration=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
size=$(stat -c%s /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4)
checksum=$(sha256sum /tmp/archflow-smoke.mp4 | cut -d' ' -f1)
test "$codec" = h264
test "$width" = 1280
test "$height" = 720
test "$frames" = 360
test "$size" -gt 100000
printf '{"event":"archflow_output_validated","codec":"%s","width":%s,"height":%s,"frames":%s,"durationSeconds":%s,"sizeBytes":%s,"sha256":"%s"}\n' "$codec" "$width" "$height" "$frames" "$duration" "$size" "$checksum"
end=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3NZ)
printf '{"event":"archflow_application_end","timestamp":"%s"}\n' "$end"
